R01.quote: **`enum status: {...}, _prefix: true`** (`app/models/note.rb:10`) raises. Use `enum :status, {...}, prefix: true`.

R02.quote: **`serialize :tags, JSON`** (`app/models/note.rb:12`) raises `ArgumentError` when the class loads. Use `coder: JSON`.

R03.quote: **`alias_attribute :highlight_color, :color`** (`app/models/note.rb:14`) raises `ArgumentError` when Note's attribute methods are first generated, because `color` is a store accessor

R04.quote: **`where(notebooks: @notebook)`** (`app/controllers/notes_controller.rb:12`): a plural name for a singular association no longer resolves, so the query hits a nonexistent `notes.notebooks` column and PostgreSQL raises.

R05.quote: `Import#receipt` uses `citation && citation[:id]` (`app/models/import.rb:68`). ... the DOI column of every downloaded receipt CSV becomes blank.

R06.quote: `Import#apply` (`app/models/import.rb:53-58`) does `return false unless row.note.save` inside `transaction`. ... when a later row fails, the `Import` and every earlier note stay saved.

R07.quote: **`fragments.sum`** on Strings (`app/models/export.rb:42`) raises `TypeError` in the worker. Use `join`.

R08.quote: `app/views/imports/preview.html.erb:22` calls `.stringify_keys`, then line 42 looks up `annotations[row.line]` with an Integer. ... every annotation silently disappears from the import preview.

R09.quote: with `load_defaults 7.0`, 8.1 drops the option, logs an `ArgumentError` at error level, reports it to `Rails.error`, and stores the fragment with no expiry

R10.quote: `Note#next_day_reminder_at` is `reminder_at.to_time + 86_400` (`app/models/note.rb:43-45`). ... The stored epoch is unchanged. Only what readers see changes

R11.quote: Digests switch from the UTC day to the reader's local day: a different subject date and a different set of notes. The Redis reservation still uses the UTC day.

R12.quote: While both versions run, a 7.0 worker can't find that serializer class. The job fails to deserialize and Sidekiq retries it until an 8.1 worker picks it up.

R13.quote: **`set(wait_until: reminder_epoch)` with an Integer** (`app/models/note.rb:61`) raises `NoMethodError` (`utc` on an Integer) when the job is serialized [code]. Use `Time.at(epoch)`.

R14.quote: **`retry_on ..., wait: :exponentially_longer`** (`app/jobs/citation_enrichment_job.rb:7`) only raises when a retry happens ... Use `:polynomially_longer`

R16.quote: **`get "/notes", "/journal", to: ...`** (`config/routes.rb:18`) raises `ArgumentError` when routes load. Split it into two `get` lines

otherGems.gem: action_text-trix, rackup, rack-session, useragent (new gems added by the upgrade)

otherFindings.summary: The Rails zone name "Astana" now maps to Asia/Almaty instead of Asia/Dhaka, which shifts stored user zones by an hour (H7).
Rails' built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated in 8.1, and moving to Sidekiq 7 affects the Redis return values and exception classes the app uses (M2).
Trix now comes from the action_text-trix gem (Trix 2), which conflicts with the vendored Trix 1.3.5, the CSS require and the importmap pin (M3).
